name: Yiedl vault forwards caller-supplied 1inch calldata
summary: The Yiedl vault's redeem path forwarded caller-supplied router calldata without validating the swap recipient, allowing one constructor transaction to deplete the vault's USDC, BTCB, and ETH inventory.
notes: The victim vault is directly deployed. Its 24,569-byte runtime is absent one block before creation and has code hash 0x74b96155073c5af9228ac8e09d90dc6d34e2eb420c0db651038ebc4c10e6bcca at creation and immediately before the incident; the EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots are zero. The vulnerable redeem behavior is in this unchanged runtime.

Gross loss is the exact ERC-20 depletion of vault 0x4edda16ab4f4cc46b160abc42763ba63885862a4 in the single successful constructor receipt. Fifty vault outflows aggregate to 75,635.138375994372050770 USDC, 0.521372360835400072 BTCB, and 8.333778171625678105 ETH, with zero inflows or returns of any component. Archive balances across block 38126754 reproduce all three deltas exactly. Later transactions from the same sender do not touch this vault or return these assets and are excluded from this single-vault boundary. USDC is valued at par; the closest preceding DefiLlama observations value BTC and ETH 134 and 200 seconds before the incident.
Replaces the seed's rounded $135,000 estimate with exact single-vault depletion and independently preceding prices for both non-stable assets.
